Riley: Quick sync from the postmortem  we need owners for the LB/DNS retry storm remediation. Please ack + ETA.

Sam: Ack. I'll own the routing backoff change (reduce cross-region retries + add sticky decay). ETA: PR by Mon EOD.

Kai: I can run the canary and smoke tests once Sam's PR is out. ETA: tests complete Wed AM.

IncidentBot: Incident 2025-12-12 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/lb-dns-retry-2025 (auto)

Jules: From logs, there's TTL skew across caches causing 30s stale routes. I'll add telemetry & dashboard tile. ETA: Thu.

Dana: I'll draft the on-call playbook and the Datadog alert for TLS/SNI spikes. ETA: Fri.

Sam: Pushed config draft: ```yaml
failover_policy:
  cross_region_retries: 1
  sticky_decay_s: 600
  backoff_ms: 300
``` PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2705

Kai: Canary started at 02:00 PT with 5% to region-b. Early metrics: retry_count -38%, tiny SNI bump 0.12%. Monitoring 2h.

Jules: Datadog metric I'll add: `sum:network.dns.ttl_skew{env:prod}.rollup(max,60)` Alert: ttl_skew > 20s on >2 nodes for 5m.

Dana: Playbook created and alert ID DD-5112. Added rollback steps & account communication template.

Sam: PR merged and rolling: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2712. Healthcheck tweak to prefer SNI validation early included.

Kai: Canary finished 3h, no customer-facing errors. Proceeding to 50% ramp tomorrow.

Riley: Great progress, thanks. I'll update the postmortem remediation tracker and close items once alerts & customer outreach are confirmed.
